title: Context, Credibility, and Control: User Reflections on AI-Assisted Misinformation Tools
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and evaluating an AI-assisted interface for misinformation detection, specifically addressing user confirmation bias and ideological leanings. While it mentions the necessity of ethical design and adheres to ethical research protocols for its user study, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics as a primary focus.
